Welcome to Wedora, a matrimonial and matchmaking service that helps people find a marriage partner. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Wedora mobile application and related services (the "Service"). Please read them carefully.

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms and by our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

2. ELIGIBILITY
You must be at least 18 years old to use Wedora. By using the Service you represent that you are 18 or older and that you are legally permitted to marry under the laws of your country, state, or jurisdiction. The Service is intended for individuals seeking a genuine marriage or long-term relationship. You may not use it on behalf of anyone else.

3. YOUR ACCOUNT
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information in your profile, for keeping your login credentials secure, and for all activity that occurs under your account. Provide true, current, and complete information — including an honest representation of your marital status — and keep it up to date. Notify us promptly of any unauthorised use of your account.

4. PROHIBITED CONDUCT
You agree not to:
• create a fake, impersonating, or misleading profile, or misrepresent your identity, age, or marital status;
• harass, threaten, abuse, or intimidate any other user;
• post or send content that is unlawful, obscene, sexually explicit, hateful, discriminatory, or otherwise inappropriate;
• solicit money from, defraud, or attempt to scam other users;
• use the Service for any commercial, advertising, or promotional purpose without our permission;
• collect or harvest other users' information, or use automated means to access the Service;
• attempt to interfere with, compromise, or circumvent the security of the Service.
We may remove content and suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

5. MATCHING AND COMMUNICATION
Wedora provides tools to discover other members, express interest, match, and exchange messages. We do not guarantee that you will find a match, that any match will lead to marriage, or the accuracy of any information provided by other users. You interact with other members at your own discretion and risk. Always exercise caution and good judgement, especially before sharing personal information or meeting anyone in person.

6. PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PAYMENTS
Some features may require a paid subscription. Prices and features are shown in the app and are processed through your device's app store (for example, Google Play). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your app store account settings before the renewal date. Except where required by law, payments are non-refundable. We may change subscription pricing or features on reasonable notice.

7. CONTENT OWNERSHIP
You retain ownership of the photos, messages, and other content you provide ("Your Content"). By submitting Your Content, you grant Wedora a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to host, store, display, and use it solely to operate and provide the Service. You are responsible for Your Content and represent that you have the right to share it. We do not claim ownership of Your Content.

8. TERMINATION AND ACCOUNT DELETION
You may delete your account at any time from Profile → Account Settings → Delete Account. Deleting your account permanently removes your profile and personal data as described in the Privacy Policy. We may suspend or terminate your access if you breach these Terms or use the Service in a way that harms other users or Wedora.

9. DISCLAIMERS AND LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Wedora and its providers are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, or for the conduct of any user, arising out of or relating to your use of the Service. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

10. GOVERNING LAW
These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Wedora operates [INSERT GOVERNING JURISDICTION], without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Any dispute will be subject to the courts of that jurisdiction, unless applicable local law grants you the right to bring proceedings elsewhere.

11. CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes we will take reasonable steps to notify you, for example within the app. Your continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

12. CONTACT
Questions about these Terms? Contact us at support@wedora.app.

This Privacy Policy explains what information Wedora collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. Wedora is a matrimonial and matchmaking service. By using the Service you agree to the practices described here.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
To provide the Service we collect information you give us and information generated as you use the app:
• Account details: your email address and password (passwords are handled by our authentication provider and are not stored by us in readable form).
• Profile information: your name, age, gender, who you are interested in, marital status, what you are looking for, and your city and country.
• Photos: a profile photo, if you choose to add one.
• Messages: the content of messages you exchange with your matches.
• Location: your approximate location (city and country), which you may provide manually or allow the app to detect.
• Usage information: basic technical information needed to operate and secure the Service.

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
We use your information to:
• create and maintain your account and profile;
• match you with other members based on your preferences;
• enable messaging between matched members;
• operate, maintain, secure, and improve the Service;
• communicate with you about your account, including verification and important notices.

3. HOW YOUR INFORMATION IS SHARED
We do not sell your personal data. Your profile information and photo are visible to other members as part of the matchmaking Service. We share information with trusted infrastructure providers who process data on our behalf — in particular Google Firebase and Google Cloud, which provide authentication, database, and hosting services. These providers are bound to use the data only to provide services to us. We may also disclose information where required by law or to protect the rights and safety of our users.

4. DATA STORAGE AND SECURITY
Your data is stored on Google Firebase / Google Cloud infrastructure. Your profile photo is stored only on your device and is not uploaded to our servers. We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, but no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. YOUR RIGHTS
You can access and correct most of your information at any time by editing your profile in the app. You can delete your account, and the personal data associated with it, from Profile → Account Settings → Delete Account. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights over your personal data; contact us to exercise them.

6. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
Wedora is intended only for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If we learn that we have collected information from a person under 18, we will delete it.

7. LOCATION DATA
We use your approximate location (city and country) to show relevant profile information and support matching. If you grant location permission, the app detects your city and country automatically; you can decline and enter them manually instead. We do not track your precise real-time location.

8. COOKIES AND ANALYTICS
The app does not use advertising cookies. Our infrastructure providers may use limited technical identifiers and basic analytics to keep the Service running reliably and secure. We do not use this information to build advertising profiles or to sell your data.

9. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes we will take reasonable steps to notify you within the app. The "Last updated" date above shows when this policy was most recently revised.

10. CONTACT
Questions about your privacy or this policy? Contact us at support@wedora.app.
